name: Jenna Brownlee
statement: My name is Jenna Brownlee and I am a Des Moines, Iowa native, painter and muralist. I create concepts that enliven spaces and serve community needs. I am an expert in translating content and vision into intentional design-work that highlights rich community values through iconic joyful imagery to capture and celebrate a sense of place. As an advocate for city pride, investing in our communities through art celebrates uniqueness, strengthens advocacy and creates a vibrant neighborhood for patrons. I find joy in bringing a sense of togetherness and celebrating inclusion through art while enhancing the cultural landscape. With a mission to make people happy through art, my work is often inspired by nature and positivity with uplifting themes using vibrant colors, collages of abstract shapes, nature and lettering.
